_comment: Which candidates go to upload/. Numbers are the NN in the filename, which
is the index of the shot() call in integration_test/store_screenshots.dart —
so 05 is the same screen in every language. Reordering that file's screen
list invalidates these numbers.
PLAY ('phone'): unchanged. Only en-US and ja have a complete 50-frame pool;
ko stopped at 30 and zh-CN / zh-TW were never shot. No Android screenshots
were captured on 2026-09-10 — that run was App Store only, by request.
APP STORE ('iphone'): en-US only, by request. 2026-09-10.
Only frames 01-20 exist. The capture run died at frame 20 on a REAL APP
BUG, not a harness fault: History's empty-search state puts a LayoutBuilder
inside SliverFillRemaining (history_screen.dart:134), which throws
'LayoutBuilder does not support returning intrinsic dimensions'. Frame 20
shows the result — the empty state renders BLANK. Home's equivalent empty
state (frame 07) is fine, so the bug is specific to History.
Frames 21-50 were therefore never reached, which cost the three shots the
Play selection leans on: 21 settings, 28 recording-in-progress, 32 dark
home. Re-run after that bug is fixed to get them.
The eight chosen from what exists, and why each earns its slot:
02 home_today           the app at a glance — waveform, detected languages,
transcript and record button in one frame
04 home_list_scrolled   several recordings stacked, each with its waveform
05 search_spoken_words  search by what was SAID, with a tappable timestamp
that plays from that moment. The differentiator.
12 playing              playback in progress: scrubbed waveform, pause
13 model_download_sheet the offline promise in the app's own words
14 history_calendar     the month grid that indexes the archive
17 history_long_transcript  what the archive becomes after a few weeks
19 history_search       searching the whole archive, not just today
